Order

WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE R. NATARAJ  ORAL ORDER

The petitioners have challenged criminal proceedings initiated against them in Crime No.108/2020 by the respondent No.1 on the information furnished by the respondent No.2 for offences punishable under Sections 498A, 504, 323, 357, 114, 327, 506 read with Section 34 of IPC and under Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
NC: 2026:KHC:16676 HC-KAR 2.

When this petition is listed for admission, an application-I.A No.1/2026 is filed under Section 528 read with Sections 359(2) and (8) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 to compound the offences.

It is stated in the application that the parties have settled their matrimonial dispute in M.C No.3/2024 and that the respondent No.2 has agreed to withdraw all cases against the petitioners including Crime No.108/2020, where the charge sheet is filed in C.C No.1003/2021.

and JMFC, Srirangapatna, is terminated.
